evals.prompt: Enable local usage capture so I can see model, latency, and which skills fire on my Claude Code requests. Do not send anything off this machine.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/usage-capture/enable.sh (optionally --dry-run first), explains restarting Claude Code, states logs land under ~/.local/share/tamirs-superpowers/usage as one JSONL file per Israel day, and does not enable OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS or --bodies unless asked.
expectations: Invokes scripts/usage-capture/enable.sh rather than hand-editing OTEL env
Tells the user to restart Claude Code
Does not turn on prompt or API-body logging by default
Does not mention a remote OTLP collector or HTTP MITM proxy as the capture path

evals.prompt: Turn on full request/response body logging for usage-capture.
evals.expected_output: Warns that bodies include conversation history, tool results, and often secrets, then uses enable.sh --bodies. Does not inline bodies into the daily JSONL.
expectations: Warns that API bodies are secret-bearing before enabling
States bodies are sidecar files plus body_ref, not inline JSONL payloads

evals.prompt: I'm on OpenCode. Record the same local usage metrics.
evals.expected_output: Reports OpenCode as partial: add the absolute path of opencode-plugin.mjs to the user's plugin list, do not edit this repo's opencode.json, start the collector, restart OpenCode. Does not claim supported from types alone.
expectations: Does not add the plugin to the repo opencode.json
Gives an absolute plugin path for the user config
Keeps compatibility at partial / unverified live fire
Still uses the same JSONL directory/schema

evals.prompt: What's the p95 LLM request duration by model today, Israel time?
evals.expected_output: Reads today's Asia/Jerusalem JSONL with jq (or equivalent). If the file is missing, says capture is not running or no requests landed — not zero usage. Does not parse ~/.claude/projects or run session-report.
expectations: Queries the usage-capture JSONL, not session-report transcripts
Does not invent percentiles when the file is absent

evals.expected_output: Runs enable.sh --disable and tells the user to restart Claude Code. Asks before deleting existing JSONL files.
